newsitem.title: UK: European vgo firms as demand rises, supplies thin.
newsitem.headline: European vgo firms as demand rises, supplies thin.

text.p: Supplies of low sulphur vacuum gas oil that threatened prices have been thinned and prices have risen to $166-168 fob NWE.
A .5 percent 50,000 tonne cargo was sold on Friday out of Donges at around $162 fob NWE on Oct 23-30 dates.
On Wednesday 5,000 tonnes of low sulphur was sold at $168 fob NWE destined for Germany.
A 25,000 tonne low sulphur cargo offered out of Scandinavia on Oct 22, that could be combined with a second around Nov 1-5, was understood to be attacting initial bids in the low $160s.

On Tuesday a high sulphur barge of 1,500 tonnes was sold at $159 fob NWE. Traders said there was little differential between barges and cargoes. There was unconfirmed talk of a Russian cargo coming in at $167 cif NWE.
